severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — HANDICRAFT INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: IMPOSSIBLE-PATTERN FRONT SWAMPS WEEKEND CRAFT CHANNELS AS SYNTHETIC KNITTING, CROCHET, AND WOODWORKING PLANS INSTRUCT RESIDENTS TO PRODUCE OBJECTS THAT DEFY YARN, GEOMETRY, AND THE NUMBER OF DIMENSIONS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE
advisory: A dense system of machine-generated craft patterns has settled over the weekend making season, saturating listings and pins with 'easy beginner' projects that cannot be completed by any known combination of hands and materials. The National Slop Service advises residents to verify that a pattern's stitch counts sum to a shape found in nature before casting on. Note that flawless product photography does not guarantee the object in the photograph exists. Refunds, where offered, are issued by a storefront that opened Tuesday and specializes in nothing.

regional_outlook.conditions: Heavy accumulation of downloadable PDF patterns bearing five-star reviews and zero completed examples. Storefronts appear, list four hundred items, and evaporate before the weekend is out.
Persistent haze of 'cozy autumn craft' pins linking to instructions that dissolve on contact. Visibility low; every board eventually loops back to the same seven synthetic mittens.
Surge in instant-published craft manuals padded to two hundred pages, of which four contain instructions and the rest contain the word 'cozy.' Index points to chapters that were never written.
Standing water of 'free pattern' pages, each demanding an email before revealing that the pattern is a picture of a pattern. Genuine crafters submerged beneath the runoff.

Scattered 'AI Pattern Generator' apps promising custom plans for any project, delivering the same impossible cardigan regardless of input. Subscription auto-renews with more confidence than the sweater has sleeves.

specimen.status: Blooming; peak season runs September through the first cold snap of resolve.
specimen.habitat: Craft marketplaces, hobby forums, and the second page of any search for 'easy weekend knit.' Prefers listings with steam rising photogenically from a mug just out of frame.
specimen.field_marks: Stitch counts that never reconcile; a garment shown with three armholes and a fourth implied; 'Row 14: repeat until desired length' where 'desired length' is undefined and Row 14 references Row 22. Yardage requirements suggest a sheep the size of a barn.
specimen.call: Beginner-friendly! Whip this cozy heirloom up in a single afternoon — no experience needed, just follow the simple steps and watch the magic happen.
specimen.confusion_species: Genuine indie craft patterns, which are also sold as PDFs by small makers. Tell them apart by the errata: a real designer posts corrections and answers questions in the comments; the synthetic pattern's designer has never answered anything and their other 'work' includes a knitted lasagna and a birdhouse with no entrance.

spotter_tip: Before you buy, scroll for a single photo of the finished item held by an actual human hand. If every image is a flawless product shot on the same beige linen, and no reviewer has posted their own attempt, you are looking at a rendering, not a recipe.
tomorrow: Impossible-pattern front lingers through Sunday; expect scattered abandoned projects and a rising tide of unraveled yarn by Monday.
